description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing entity-to-entity mappings in the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting mappings between entities, with methods annotated for HTTP GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations. The class utilizes dependency injection, security checks, serialization, and command processing components.

classes.name: FineractEntityApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class that handles HTTP requests for managing entity-to-entity mappings within the Fineract API, including methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of mapping data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all supported entity mapping types.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific entity-to-entity mapping by its ID.

methods.name: getEntityToEntityMappings
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve mappings between specific entities identified by mapId, fromId, and toId.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new entity-to-entity mapping using provided JSON data.

methods.name: updateMap
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing mapping identified by mapId with provided JSON data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a mapping identified by mapId.
